item.title: Songs that are wholly or largely created by generative A.I. …
item.author: The New York Times (@nytimes.com)
item.description: Songs that are wholly or largely created by generative A.I. will be banned from Australia’s music charts. Under new rules announced Tuesday, recordings developed using the technology will only be allowed if they are “substantially human-made.”
